performancePage.pillarBoundedPeakDesc: Desktop pin hot-pixel pool is capped at 256 MB (auto lossless PNG compression shrinks idle pins by 85%-95%), unsaved capture history is capped at 32 MB, and long screenshots run tiled OCR.
performancePage.pillarColdPathDesc: Silent watermark trims gently pull the main process back when private working set reaches 14 MB while all UIs are hidden, strictly avoiding 1000Hz mouse/keyboard hooks and animations.
performancePage.layerIsolation: 1. On-Demand Launch & Process Isolation (0 MB When Idle)
performancePage.layerMediaBudget: 2. Pin, Capture & Clipboard Budget Caps (4K Spike Protection)
performancePage.layerWebView: 3. WebView2 UI Host Lifecycle (Warm Suspend & Auto-Destroy)
performancePage.layerAiModels: 4. Offline AI Vision & Deep Learning (Staged Unload to Zero)
performancePage.layerGpuOverlays: 5. Native Overlays & GPU Composition Surfaces (Minimal Viewport)
performancePage.layerKernelGuard: 6. Main Process Watermark & Kernel Anti-Thrash Guards
performancePage.itemSearchSvcDesc: Starts strictly on first explicit search summon (0 processes on Windows boot or app startup); supports resident, idle trim, and idle stop modes
performancePage.itemSearchSvcValStop: On-demand · Sleep & exit after {{minutes}}m idle (0 MB)
performancePage.itemWindowKitDesc: Zero-WebView2 native process. Stays at 0 processes / 0 MB when disabled or all sub-features are off; drops D2D factory and trims working set 2s after overlays hide
performancePage.itemWindowKitValActive: Running · Drop D2D & trim 2s after overlay hides
performancePage.itemShortWorkersTitle: File Dialog, Recording Encode & Locksmith Workers
performancePage.itemShortWorkersDesc: System file pickers, video encoding/export, media probe, and File Locksmith run in ephemeral child processes so third-party cloud shell extensions & 60+ MB .NET CLR never stick in main RAM
performancePage.itemModularPluginsTitle: Modular Feature Toggles & Lightweight Native Tools
performancePage.itemModularPluginsDesc: Disabling any module stops its threads and unloads resources; Picasa Viewer launches only while viewing images; CapsLayer short-circuits atomically with zero helper processes when off
performancePage.itemModularPluginsVal: Unload on disable · 0 background footprint when off
performancePage.itemPinPixelPoolTitle: Desktop Pin Hot-Pixel Pool & Lossless Compression
performancePage.itemPinPixelPoolDesc: Uncompressed CPU pixels strictly capped at 256 MB; overflow (LRU) or 30s idle auto-compresses losslessly (-85% to -95%). Fold/hide immediately unloads D2D textures; <=65% scale switches to light LOD
performancePage.itemPinPixelPoolVal: 256 MB cap · 30s idle lossless compress · Instant unload on fold
performancePage.itemPinOcrQueueTitle: Pin OCR Single-Flight Queue & Long-Image Tiling
performancePage.itemPinOcrQueueDesc: Concurrency locked to 1 with zero queued image clones; >3.8 MP or >6 active pins defer OCR until hover; >2800px images slice into 2048px tiles to bound IPC RAM
performancePage.itemCaptureHistoryDesc: Saved captures keep only a ~15 KB 160px thumbnail and hydrate from disk on demand; unsaved clipboard-only captures store PNG streams capped at 32 MB and 20 items
performancePage.itemCaptureHistoryVal: 0 full-image RAM if saved · 32 MB / 20-item unsaved cap
performancePage.itemClipboardStoreDesc: Pure Rust store keeps a compact index while releasing raw bitmap buffers after disk persistence; single text entries cap at 512 KB and oldest entries auto-prune by count and age
performancePage.itemClipboardStoreVal: 512 KB text cap · Disk-backed images · Auto retention prune
performancePage.itemSettingsDesc: Suspends renderer immediately on close; when auto-release is enabled, destroys the WebView2 instance after idle timeout to reclaim full page memory
performancePage.itemSettingsValEnabled: Suspend on close · Destroy after idle (5m SSD / 15m HDD)
performancePage.itemSettingsValDisabled: Suspend on close · Keep instance warm
performancePage.itemClipboardDesc: Keeps GPU frame warm for rapid sequential pastes, suspends after 25s, and destroys the renderer completely after 90s idle
performancePage.itemQuickLookDesc: Keeps preview host warm for 60s across rapid file browsing, then destroys automatically; destroys immediately if the module is disabled
performancePage.itemQuickLookVal: Destroy after 60s idle · Instant destroy when disabled
performancePage.itemSearchWndTitle: Global Search Box & Tray Control Center
performancePage.itemSearchWndDesc: Suspends into minimal physical working set after hiding to guarantee zero-blank instant summon at any time
performancePage.itemSearchWndVal: Search 25s suspend · Tray immediate suspend (warm summon)
performancePage.itemOcrWorkerDesc: Soft-trims VRAM at 60s while preserving compiled DirectML graphs for fast reuse, then exits cleanly at 15m idle for 0 MB
performancePage.itemDeepOcrDesc: Used only when isolated worker fallback triggers; automatically unloads detection and recognition neural weights after 120s idle
performancePage.itemMiganDesc: Loaded on demand only for AI background repair; unloads WinML session and trims VRAM/heap automatically after 90s idle
performancePage.itemGestureTrailDesc: Zero pre-allocated fullscreen surface at startup; allocates DirectComposition canvas on first gesture and releases surfaces + DXGI trim after 30s idle
performancePage.itemGestureTrailVal: Lazy first-use alloc · 30s idle surface & DXGI release
performancePage.itemMouseDcompDesc: Click ripples and glow shrink to a dynamic minimal bounding box (-99% composition cost, avoids Focus Assist); releases GPU surface after 60s idle
performancePage.itemMouseDcompVal: Minimal bounding box · Release GPU surface after 60s idle
performancePage.itemInstantOverlaysTitle: Quick Translate Popup & Cinema Smooth Zoom
performancePage.itemInstantOverlaysDesc: Quick Translate uses zero-WebView2 native D2D and drops text/render caches on close; Cinema Zoom immediately unloads Magnification session and thread once back at 1.0x
performancePage.itemInstantOverlaysVal: Instant D2D & Magnification session release on close/exit
performancePage.itemWatermarkGuardDesc: Checks every 10s strictly when all app UIs are hidden and no mouse button is pressed; gently trims working set & unused COM once private WS >= 14 MB or total WS >= 24 MB
performancePage.itemWatermarkGuardVal: 10s check · 60s cooldown · Trim at Priv >=14 MB / Total >=24 MB
performancePage.itemHeapGuardTitle: Safe Heap Compact, Whitelist Trim & Hot-Path Lock
performancePage.itemHeapGuardDesc: Compacts only UCRT & default process heap on cold paths (never touches foreign DLL private heaps), cascades trim only to WebView2 children (protects search index), and never touches 1000Hz hooks
performancePage.itemHeapGuardVal: 2.5-5.5s idle debounce · 2.0s throttle · Own-heap safe compact
